column1: # Brunei Darussalam labour force - counts of persons, aged 18 and over
# Compiled from published tables of the Department of Economic Planning and
# Statistics (DEPS), Ministry of Finance and Economy: deps.mofe.gov.bn/labour-force/
# Labour Force Survey (2025 figures are the PRELIMINARY report) and the
# Labour Market Indicators 18+ series. This is real official data, not mock data.
# Counts only. Every rate you need is yours to compute - that is the exercise.
# Figures are survey estimates and are rounded; sub-group differences of a few
# hundred persons may sit inside sampling error. The coefficients of variation
# are in the DEPS report and are NOT in this file.
# DEPS notes that data may not add up to totals because of rounding. That is
# true of this extract too, in two places. They have been left in.
